task.title: Access Environment Temperature
task.shortdesc: This section describes the process of accessing the environment temperature scatter plot.

context.p: This section describes the process of accessing the environment temperature scatter plot.
To access the Environmental Temperature scatter plot through the application:

step.cmd: Select the location associated with the motor.
From the subsequent screens, select the corresponding process, plant, and motor name.
Select History Plot and P erformance.
Tap Select … to select Environment temperature.

info.p: You should see the corresponding scatter plot as shown in Figure 42.

fig.title: Dashboard screen showing the Environment temperature scatter plot

step.cmd: Click DATA DOWNLOADto download the generated data.
